evidence:
## fix(core): Keep parentheses around && and || operands of ?? in expressions

extendTransform's recast reprint dropped parentheses around &&/|| operands of ?? when both ?? operands were reprinted (e.g. `($a?.b && $c) ?? $x?.y`), giving a syntax error. Before printing, those operands are now marked parenthesized so recast keeps the parentheses. Added tests.

### What changed
- 1 source file(s), 1 test file(s), 50 changed lines
- `packages/workflow/src/extensions/expression-extension.ts`

### What ran
- The agent ran the tests 14 time(s) and says: Expression-extension tests: 96 passed. acdc-lint on changed files: 0 errors. acdc-typecheck printed no errors, run before the last test edit (an esprima-next import) and not re-run. Full packages/workflow/test run: 5475 passed, 1 failed, 10 skipped. The failure is native-evaluation-parity > 'an own __proto__ key on a whole-value read hands off to the engine' (quickjs-engine), which doesn't involve ??, &&, or ||. I did not run it on a clean baseline, so I haven't confirmed it also fails without my change.
- Type check: passes; lint: passes
- Tests for the issue: 5/5; tests that passed before: 240/240

### Risks that remain
- Change risk: medium (10% chance of a revert or follow-up fix, from n8n's history)
- One test in the full packages/workflow suite fails (the quickjs __proto__ parity test). It looks unrelated, but check it on a clean master to confirm.
- Relies on recast honoring node.extra.parenthesized in its generic printer. I saw no doubled parentheses on reused or reprinted operands in the cases tried.
- The comment and fallback in native-evaluation/parser.ts usesPolyfilledChain are now partly redundant; left untouched.
- The new tests were not run against the unfixed code. I only saw the broken output in debug runs before the fix.

### Where a person decides
- Autonomy level: **agent reviewed**
- category bugfix: at most agent_reviewed

- Agent cost: $0.44

judge.reason: The change uses the same approach as the merged fix: after traversal, it marks && and || operands of ?? as parenthesized so recast reprints them with parentheses. It spreads the existing extra and casts to any, which is slightly less clean than Object.assign but behaves the same, and no hidden tests fail.
